Agents.Title: Agents
Agents.Explain: An agent is instructions, a model, tools and a permission mode. Today Kam creates role agents for a task on its own and can hand coding work to Codex. Saved agents that you configure yourself are coming next.
Agents.Empty.Title: No role agents yet
Agents.Empty.Body: They appear here when a task delegates work to a role agent, such as a researcher or a reviewer.

Agents.Cli.Codex.About: OpenAI's coding agent for your terminal. Kam can hand it a coding task and shows you the whole brief before anything runs.
Agents.Cli.Claude.About: Anthropic's coding agent for your terminal. Kam detects it but does not hand tasks to it yet.
